name: tariff-duty-mcp
display_name: US & UK Import Tariffs and Duty Rates
description: US HTS and UK Trade Tariff: HS code search, duty rates by origin and rough landed-cost estimates.
long_description: Looks up import tariff codes and duty rates for the United States (USITC HTS) and the United Kingdom (UK Trade Tariff API) live from official keyless APIs: HS code search by product description, General/FTA/column 2 rates or UK third-country duty and preferences for a country of origin, and a rough landed-cost estimate (US duty, MPF and HMF; UK duty and import VAT) with assumptions and warnings. Reference data, not customs advice.

tools.name: search_hs_code
tools.description: Find candidate tariff classification codes for a product description.

tools.name: get_duty_rate
tools.description: Import duty rates for one tariff code, optionally for a specific country of origin.

tools.name: estimate_landed_cost
tools.description: Estimate import duty, taxes/fees and landed cost for one shipment line.
